decisions.text: Delivery charge below ₹500 is ₹50
Cash on Delivery extra charge is ₹50
Maximum Cash on Delivery order is ₹5,000
Beauty products are non-returnable unless damaged or wrong
Delivery and COD charges not refunded on normal returns (refunded if our mistake)
Exchanges only for same-or-lower-priced sizes/colours of the same product
Shipping booked by hand with any courier; tracking typed into admin
Cancellation allowed only before the order is shipped
Maximum 5 units per size/colour per order
Customers must log in to check out (no guest checkout)
No coupons in version 1.0
Review edits allowed within 30 days and checked again
Delivery estimate "4–7 business days" across India
Your web address (domain), e.g. shopme.in
Business contact details, WhatsApp, address, logo
"Remember me" keeps customers logged in 30 days; otherwise until the browser closes
Up to 10 saved addresses; 50 items in a cart; 200 in a wishlist
Refunds started within 2 business days; return requests reviewed within 2 business days
Prepaid orders that come back undelivered are refunded in full
Accounts unused for 3 years may be deleted after 48 hours’ notice
Proprietor and Grievance Officer named on the policies (RESHMA PR)
Is return pickup free for the customer?
Razorpay test keys (to switch on online payments)
Use a free pincode lookup to fill city and state automatically?
GitHub repository link (to protect production online)
OK to upgrade Vite and React Router to new major versions (security advisories)
